review_candidates.title: Développement commercial
review_candidates.description: Stepwize is looking for a Freelance B2B Business Developer in Egypt We are looking for someone based in Cairo for an initial 1-month paid test mission. Your mission Your objective is to develop business opportunities for Stepwize in Egypt. We will provide you with the companies to target, prospecting scripts, a structured audit questionnaire, qualification criteria and a clear methodology. Your role will be to identify the right business owners and decision-makers, contact them, open conversations and secure meetings. You will be able to use phone, LinkedIn, networking, referrals and face-to-face meetings with prospects. A key part of your mission will be conducting business audits. During these conversations, your objective is not simply to present or sell Stepwize. You will first need to understand how the company actually operates. You will use our audit framework to understand which processes already exist, which ones are documented, which activities still depend on the owner or key employees, what information needs to be repeated regularly and where the company experiences bottlenecks, mistakes or loss of time. You will be expected to ask questions, listen carefully, explore the answers and collect concrete examples. You will then follow up with the companies and manage relevant opportunities toward a potential pilot. What matters to us We are not looking for someone whose performance is simply measured by the number of calls made or LinkedIn messages sent. Calls and messages are tools. They are not the final objective. We will primarily evaluate the quality and number of business audits conducted, the quality of the information collected and your ability to turn conversations into genuine business opportunities. Who we are looking for You must be based in Cairo or Greater Cairo, fluent in Arabic and comfortable working professionally in English. You should be comfortable speaking with business owners and senior managers, both remotely and face-to-face. We are looking for someone curious, structured, autonomous and capable of asking good questions and listening carefully. Previous experience in B2B sales, business development, consulting or prospecting is a plus. The collaboration This is a freelance position starting with a 1-month paid test mission. If the first month is successful, our objective is to continue with an initial 3-month collaboration with performance-based commission. Depending on the results and development of the Egyptian market, the collaboration could then continue on a longer-term freelance basis or evolve into a permanent position. Interested? Apply through LinkedIn with a short introduction about your experience and why you think you would be a good fit for this mission.
